notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Hello, adventure chasers!

It's been a while since we have made an announcement. We are very happy and excited at the same time to make this announcement to you. We have finally decided on a release date to launch the game. It's a very big step for us after all these efforts and blood, sweat... aaand all the other things, you know.

We've decided to release the game on the 6th of January 2022.

Firstly, we have planned to release the game in Q3 of 2021, but we admit, it was too optimistic. Then we thought we could do it in Q4 but here we are. The game is almost ready but we are making sure we left no room for bugs, errors, and etc. The localizations are almost done too. Besides these, we'll do our best to spread the word to as many people as we can to let the world know about Crowalt and Hugh's journey.

Thanks to all fans who have come this far with following us. We've put a lot of love into this game since this is our very first game to be released. We hope that it'll be a nice start and then we'll be able to show you more works of ours in the future.

Let's spread the word; 6th of Jan, 2022!

Stay safe, stay healthy.

notes.title: PUBLISHING PARTNERSHIP WITH GRABTHEGAMES
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37232285/8f02689696d902ba4bdb4f5f7fdea68bbe59ee43.png[/img]

Dear followers, 

We want to announce a huge step that we took for Crowalt. 
Crowalt is going to be published by [url=https://www.grabthegames.com/]GrabTheGames[/url]! 

We have a small community that consists of our Steam followers and social media followers (in Twitter, Discord & Instagram). We have been trying to spread the word as much as we can (as others call it marketing), but it has its own difficulties when you keep developing the game itself on another side. So, for the last couple of months, we have been looking for a publishing partner that could help us making Crowalt reach its potential. We have talked to a bunch of publishers, but the moment when we started talking with GrabTheGames, we knew that working with them will be very exciting if things work out. We are very glad that it happened. 

So, what difference will this partnership make? 

GrabTheGames is a very experienced publisher but not just a publisher, but a community at the same time. They'll help us with marketing, PR, testing, also with localization so that Crowalt will be playable in many different languages. Porting is also a possibility regarding this partnership. 

Besides these, most important thing is that we'll be able to give all of our focus to the creative side and make our best to bring a really tasty and enjoyable product to your tables. We are very excited about the final version of Crowalt. We believe that you'll like it a lot. Now, we are stronger than ever! 

Don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/crowaltgame]social[/url] [url=https://www.instagram.com/crowalt_game/]media[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/J7yKH9xRme]Discord[/url] for a further chat. <3

See you soon adventurers!

notes.title: Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37232285/7c907ce69f2bcffd58929e32aa9670c9f742304c.png[/img]
We are thrilled to announce that we are going to release our demo first time by participating Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition! 

We are currently in a hard work process but we believe that it is going to totally worth it. The dream of seeing the first comments on the demo is our igniter which keeps us motivated and far from being exhausted. We hope that we will keep this feeling for years while our community grows with your support. 

We're going to plan [i]live events[/i] to hear more from you about our game. We will be sharing the details of these events in the upcoming days of September.

Please make sure you are following us on social media [b]([url=https://twitter.com/crowaltgame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/crowalt_game/]Instagram[/url])[/b] to see our progress more updated with in-game screens, gifs, and other kinds of dev logs. And of course, please add Crowalt to your [b][i]wishlist[/i][/b], it helps a lot.

[b]We hope that October is gonna be great and we are very excited about it![/b]
